entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A legendary Master Wizard, husband of Rayne and father of Hanna, who aided Urza in defending Dominaria.

entities.name: Pharon
entities.description: A dying wizard who taught Barrinalo the Blare of Doom and told him to become the most powerful wizard.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who enlisted Barrin as headmaster of the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: A Tolarian native, later the Academy's chancellor, Barrin's wife, slain by Greel.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Barrin and Rayne's daughter, who chose artifice and died of a Phyrexian disease.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver probe created by Urza and Barrin, named from the Thran for 'mighty', sent back in time.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An immortal companion who unknowingly gave the time machine's plans to Kerrick.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: A Phyrexian who attacked Tolaria and built a pocket Phyrexia in a rift.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Barrin's former pupil and a planeswalker defending southeastern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Greel
entities.description: A Keldon mutation with damaging telepathy who slew Rayne.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: The Keldon overlord killed by Barrin.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian god whose death cloud turned Barrin, Rayne and Hanna briefly undead.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders of Dominaria and attackers of Tolaria.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: A school of wizards founded by Urza and Barrin around 3285 AR to defend Dominaria.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: The nation that invaded southeastern Jamuraa and whose army Barrin demolished.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island home of the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The Terisiarian kingdom where Barrinalo was born.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: The site of the battle where Barrin discovered Hanna had died.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A plane Urza invaded to empower the Weatherlight's powerstone.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship whose powerstone Urza sought to empower.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: The disaster that created a rift destroying the Academy and killing hundreds.

entities.name: Invasion of Tolaria
entities.description: Kerrick's assault on Tolaria with modified Phyrexians.

entities.name: Prophecy War
entities.description: The war in southeastern Jamuraa against Keld, whose final battle killed Rayne.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Urza's project to which the Academy's focus shifted.

events.summary: Scribe Barrinalo records Pharon's dying words, leaves Kjeld and adopts the name Barrin when ink runs while signing out.
events.quote: he adopted the name "Barrin" in recognition of his new life

events.summary: Urza enlists Barrin as headmaster, and they found the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR.
events.quote: they founded the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR

events.summary: Kerrick attacks Tolaria after getting the time machine plans; Karn is sent back in time to stop him, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster that destroys the Academy.
events.quote: creating a rift that destroyed the Academy and resulted in the deaths of hundreds of students and faculty

events.summary: Urza, Barrin and Karn return to Tolaria and reestablish the Academy with Jhoira's aid.
events.quote: Urza, Barrin, and Karn later returned to Tolaria and reestablished the Academy

events.summary: Kerrick launches the Invasion of Tolaria while Urza is away; Barrin activates a beacon and Urza returns to destroy Kerrick.
events.quote: Urza and his Shivan reinforcements attacked and destroyed Kerrick

events.summary: In Urza's invasion of Serra's Realm, Barrin battles the Phyrexian overlord.
events.quote: Barrin battled the Phyrexian overlord in charge of the Serran government's displacement

events.summary: Barrin weds Rayne, then realizes Urza chose her as his mate for the Bloodlines.
events.quote: Barrin realized that Rayne was selected as his mate by Urza

events.summary: Barrin forbids Hanna from studying artifacts, causing a falling-out and her move to New Argive.
events.quote: Barrin forbade Hanna from studying the artifacts

events.summary: Greel slays Rayne in the final battle of the Prophecy War, and Barrin in rage destroys the Keldon army, Greel and the overlord Latulla.
Barrin uses more slow water to reverse his aging before the Phyrexian assault.
events.quote: the water not only slowed his aging but reversed it

events.summary: Barrin defends Benalia, Keld and Urborg before retreating, and learns at Koilos that Hanna has died of a Phyrexian disease and exhumes her body.
events.quote: Barrin exhumed the body of his daughter from the sands of Koilos.

events.summary: Barrin returns to Tolaria and casts a spell he vowed never to cast, destroying the island, the Phyrexians, the academy and himself.
events.quote: Barrin cast a spell he had vowed never to cast

events.summary: Barrin, Rayne and Hanna are briefly turned undead when Yawgmoth's death cloud enters the plane.
events.quote: were all briefly turned into undead
